categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in four core business segments: antenna products, thermal management devices and modules, wiring harnesses and connectors, and smart modules. These products serve the consumer electronics, automotive, communications, and new energy sectors. The antenna segment includes various types such as FPC, LDS, LAP, UWB, and automotive-specific antennas. Thermal management products include heat pipes, vapor chambers, liquid cooling plates, and modules. Wiring harnesses focus on high and low voltage battery pack harnesses for new energy vehicles. Smart modules cover sensor modules for automotive and industrial applications, fingerprint modules, touchpad modules, wireless charging, and WiFi/Bluetooth modules.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies including laser direct structuring (LDS) for antenna manufacturing, electromagnetic simulation for antenna design, and precision manufacturing for thermal management components. Production follows ISO9001 standards with ERP system management, emphasizing customized, order-driven procurement and manufacturing. The company invests heavily in R&D, focusing on 5G antennas compatible with metal frames, transparent antennas, and AI-related terminal products. It also integrates automation and intelligent equipment to enhance production efficiency and quality.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading domestic and international companies in the smartphone, PC, automotive, and new energy vehicle industries. The company serves major handset manufacturers, automotive OEMs, and industrial clients requiring advanced sensor modules and thermal solutions. The markets are primarily in wireless communication terminals, automotive electronics, consumer electronics, and renewable energy sectors. The company maintains strategic partnerships with top-tier clients and continuously expands its customer base domestically and overseas.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production bases in the Pearl River Delta, Yangtze River Delta, and Southeast Asia, including Vietnam. It has established subsidiaries and offices in Taiwan, South Korea, the United States, and Vietnam to support overseas market development. The domestic sales account for approximately 77% of revenue, while exports constitute about 23%. The company actively pursues growth in both domestic and international markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the wireless communication and automotive electronics supply chains. It designs, manufactures, and sells key components such as antennas, thermal modules, wiring harnesses, and smart sensor modules that are integrated into end products by OEMs. It acts as a key parts supplier to device manufacturers and automotive companies, focusing on customized solutions and direct sales to customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company emphasizes technological innovation, lean management, and team development to become a global leader in core component solutions. R&D priorities include 5G antenna technologies, AI-enabled terminal products, transparent antennas, and advanced thermal management solutions. The company plans to increase R&D investment, strengthen collaboration with customers, and accelerate product commercialization. It also focuses on internal process optimization and cost reduction to enhance competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of customized products to customers in the communications, automotive, consumer electronics, and new energy sectors. The company follows an order-driven production model, with revenue recognized upon transfer of control of goods to customers. It also earns income from government subsidies and investment returns. The business model is product sales-centric with a focus on high-quality, value-added components.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: While specific competitors are not named, the company positions itself as a leading supplier of wireless communication antennas, thermal management products, wiring harnesses, and smart modules in China and internationally. It competes by leveraging strong R&D capabilities, diversified product lines, and high-quality manufacturing. The company has won multiple customer awards for quality and collaboration, indicating a strong market position among peers in the electronics and automotive component industries.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.86 billion, a 12.37% increase over 2023. Despite continued net losses, the net loss attributable to shareholders improved significantly by 66.87% compared to the previous year. Total assets reached about RMB 3.06 billion, up 6.27% year-over-year. The company has experienced steady revenue growth driven by core business segments, with ongoing efforts to reduce losses and improve profitability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its core technological strengths, extensive patent portfolio, and ability to provide customized, high-quality component solutions. Its products support advanced applications such as 5G communications, AI-enabled devices, automotive smart systems, and new energy vehicles. The integration of R&D, manufacturing excellence, and customer-centric service enables it to deliver differentiated products with enhanced performance, reliability, and innovation. This positions the company as a trusted partner for leading OEMs seeking cutting-edge wireless and thermal solutions.
